form_data.facts_narrative: The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with FIR No. 215/2026 dated 10.04.2026 lodged at PS Gandhi Maidan, Patna. The FIR has been lodged on the basis of a false complaint by the de-facto complainant arising out of a business dispute. The applicant is a businessman of standing in the community with no criminal antecedents. He undertakes to cooperate fully with the investigation and not to leave the territorial jurisdiction of the State of Bihar without prior permission of the Hon'ble Court.
